description: Dreadnaught Breastplate Level 60 Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Dreadnaught Breastplate if you bring him the following items: 1 Desecrated Breastplate, 25 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 4 Arcanite Bars and 2 Nexus Crystals. Requirements: - Desecrated Breastplate - Wartorn Plate Scrap x 25 - Arcanite Bar x 4 - Nexus Crystal x 2
name: Dreadnaught Breastplate
